placements.title: Participant data is kept only as long as consent reaches
placements.frame: How long is participant data kept, and what does the reach of participant consent say about which artifacts may outlast it?
placements.why: The position carries the recording retention change, the consent-renewal evidence behind it, and the permanent keeping of transcripts. These are about one subject, how retention terms for participant data relate to consent, which future envelopes will keep feeding. The leaf names the theme and not the eighteen-to-twelve-month figures, which stay in the position as evidence. The graph is empty, so there is nothing to reuse and no structure to sit under.

mints.why: A cross-document grouping of everything said about retaining participant recordings and transcripts. Future retention and consent calls will connect to it.
